csharpCode: using UnityEngine; using Unity.Netcode.Components; using UnityEditor; public class FixEnemyAnimators { public static string Run() { string log = ""; string[] paths = { "Assets/Prefabs/Mimic.prefab", "Assets/AI Toolkit/Enami/EnamiMutant.prefab" }; foreach (string path in paths) { GameObject prefab = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameObject>(path); if (prefab == null) continue; bool changed = false; if (prefab.GetComponent<NetworkAnimator>() == null) { var na = prefab.AddComponent<NetworkAnimator>(); na.Animator = prefab.GetComponentInChildren<Animator>(); log += path + " added NetworkAnimator.\n"; changed = true; } if (changed) { EditorUtility.SetDirty(prefab); PrefabUtility.SavePrefabAsset(prefab); } } return log + "Done."; } }
